title: Trademark Registration in Kollam: Documents, Process and Common Mistakes
metaTitle: Trademark Registration in Kollam | BRNDNUR Advisory
metaDescription: Comprehensive guide for Kollam business owners on trademark registration. Required documents, official fees, class selection, and common filing mistakes.
intendedAudience: Entrepreneurs, cashew processing facility owners, marine exporters, and retail business operators across Kollam district.
quickAnswer: To register a trademark in Kollam, conduct a clearance search on the IP India database, choose the appropriate Nice class, and file Form TM-A online with the Trade Marks Registry. Required documents include applicant PAN/Aadhaar, Udyam MSME certificate (to secure the 50% statutory fee discount of ₹4,500 instead of ₹9,000), a high-resolution logo, and proof of prior commercial use if claiming an earlier date.

h2Sections.h2: Kollam’s Industrial Landscape: From Cashew Capital to Modern Commerce
content: Known historically as the cashew capital of the world and a major commercial seaport on the Ashtamudi Lake, Kollam possesses a diverse business economy encompassing agro-processing, seafood export, titanium and mineral extraction, traditional tile factories, and modern retail chains along Chinnakada and Residency Road.

As second- and third-generation business owners in Kollam modernize legacy packaging and transition into branded retail distribution, safeguarding commercial identity through formal trademark registration is vital to protect market share against local and national counterfeiters.
Preparing your documentation accurately before initiating Form TM-A prevents Formalities Check Failures by the Trade Marks Registry:
checklist: Identity & Address Proof: PAN card and Aadhaar card (for individuals/proprietors) or Certificate of Incorporation & Board Resolution (for companies/LLPs).
Udyam Registration Certificate: Crucial to claim the statutory 50% filing fee concession under Rule 11 of the Trade Marks Rules 2017.
Representation of the Mark: Clear wordmark string or high-resolution JPEG/PNG artwork for device logos or labels.

User Affidavit (If Claiming Prior Use): Notarized affidavit signed by the applicant accompanied by date-stamped commercial invoices, GST bills, or packaging proving the exact date the mark was first used in India.
Power of Attorney (Form TM-48): Executed on prescribed stamp paper authorizing an accredited trademark agent or attorney.

h2Sections.h2: Three Critical Mistakes Kollam Founders Must Avoid
content: Many Kollam business owners encounter avoidable rejections due to procedural oversights:

callout.title: 1. Filing as "Proposed to be Used" When Already Trading
callout.text: If you have been selling under your brand name for years in Kollam, filing as "proposed to be used" forfeits your prior use seniority, making it harder to defend against a recent copycat who claims an earlier fictitious use date.

rows: Terms like "Premium Cashews" or "Super Fresh Seafood" face refusal under Section 9(1)(b).
Coin arbitrary, fanciful, or suggestive names (e.g., "Cashewnova", "Aquanur").
Filing cashew kernel exports under Class 31 (raw agriculture) instead of Class 29 (processed nuts).
Verify processed food classifications under Class 29 before submission.
Failing to file an official response to an Examination Report within the strict 30-day statutory window.
Monitor application status weekly and submit reasoned legal rebuttals promptly.

faqs.question: Which Trade Marks Registry branch handles Kollam applications?
faqs.answer: All trademark applications from Kollam and the rest of Kerala are under the territorial jurisdiction of the Trade Marks Registry Chennai, located in Guindy.

faqs.question: How much does government trademark filing cost for a Kollam MSME?
faqs.answer: With an active Udyam MSME certificate, the official government filing fee is ₹4,500 per class (e-filing). Without Udyam, corporate entities pay ₹9,000 per class.
